summary: @onereach/idw-ui-components preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (_0x... variables, per-function alias tables mapping method calls and string constants such as '--version', '/etc/os-release', 'Alpine'). It constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, downloads the Bun runtime binary, chmods it 0755, and then execFileSyncs the Bun binary against a bundled sibling file math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a ~730 KB single-line file tagged '// @bun @bun-cjs' with mangled identifiers, a ~thousand-entry string/number constant table, and a rotation function (WV8StW) that shifts that table — a heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled payload. The package is advertised as a UI-components library and has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime; the effect of `npm install @onereach/idw-ui-components` is to fetch a runtime specifically to execute a concealed payload that Node-based scanners do not inspect. Both the preinstall dropper and the executed payload are obfuscated, and the payload's name ('math_init') is unrelated to the stated UI purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
